purpose: Reconcile candidate metadata against Kattis source/author fields exposed in Virtual Judge records, correct Pass 22 interpretation for Build Dependencies, and continue primary statement retrieval.

records.title: Build Dependencies
records.finding: Correction/clarification to Pass 22: a VJudge record exposes Kattis problem metadata for slug builddeps with source Northwestern Europe Regional Contest (NWERC) 2015 Practice and author Jeroen Bransen. The record marks the problem description official/mainOfficial, but the content retrieved here is a VJudge rendering of Kattis metadata, not the original practice-session statement. The inspected NWERC 2015 main-contest packet contains a separate set of 11 main-contest problems and does not include Build Dependencies; that observation does not contradict a separately labeled practice source. Source attribution is now metadata-corroborated, not primary-statement-verified.

sourceEvidence.observation: Build Dependencies / builddeps; source field links to official Kattis NWERC 2015 Practice source page; author Jeroen Bransen; description marked official and mainOfficial.

records.nextGate: Retrieve the NWERC 2015 Practice statement/package or the Kattis statement text and inspect its full narrative, input/output, examples, and constraints.
